syllabus.details: General Studies: current affairs (national and international events, scientific progress, awards, sports and players). Also India and its neighbouring countries: history of neighbouring countries; history, culture, geography, economic scene, agriculture and natural resources of India and Bihar; the Constitution and political system of India; Panchayati Raj; community development; Five-Year Plans; the freedom movement and Bihar's contribution to it. Questions may focus on Bihar, India and neighbouring countries. General Science and Mathematics: mainly matric level. Physics, Chemistry and Biology; number system, computation of whole numbers, decimals and fractions, relationship between numbers, fundamental arithmetical operations, percentage, ratio and proportion, average, interest, and profit and loss. Mental Ability and Logical Reasoning: verbal and non-verbal questions on analogies, similarities and differences, space visualisation, problem solving, analysis, visual memory, discrimination, observation, relationship concepts, arithmetical reasoning, arithmetic number series, and coding and decoding.

how_to_apply: Applications are accepted online only, through the "Apply Online" link given in the notice (bvscap.in). Registration opens on 7 November 2026 from 11:00 AM. Printed, typed or handwritten applications will not be accepted, and in that case the fee will not be refunded.
Register and fill the online application between 7 November 2026 (11:00 AM) and 6 December 2026. Use your own working mobile number and e-mail ID.
Upload scanned copies of your educational qualification certificate and reservation certificates, a recent photograph and your signature. Check that each uploaded image is clear.
Pay the examination fee online by Net Banking, Credit Card or Debit Card by 6 December 2026. Bank charges are payable in addition to the fee. Keep a printout of the bank receipt.
After the final submission, log in again and download the filled form from the "Download Filled Application Section" on the dashboard.
Print two copies. Check that every page shows the Bar Code and the Application Number. If either is missing, the application will be treated as incomplete and will not be accepted.
Keep at least five extra copies of the uploaded photograph, along with copies of all certificates. Produce the hard copy and the certificates whenever the secretariat asks for them.

The fee is paid online while applying, and the last date for payment is 6 December 2026. An SC or ST candidate who pays the SC/ST fee but later does not produce the SC/ST certificate, or whose certificate is in doubt, may be disqualified. Such candidates may choose to pay the fee for general candidates, in which case their candidature remains safe on this point.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice lists 15 provisional posts by reservation category. Under the 35% horizontal reservation for women, 4 of these posts are for women. The number of advertised posts may decrease or increase.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The candidate must be a citizen of India. By the last date of the online application, candidates must have passed Intermediate or an equivalent examination in any subject from an Intermediate Council or Board recognised by the State Government or the Central Government. The notice treats Hindi and English typing at 30 words per minute each as desirable. Please see the official notification for the full eligibility details for the post. The minimum age is 18 years as on 01 August 2026. Age is counted from the date of birth recorded in the matriculation or equivalent certificate. Candidates who claim any of these relaxations must submit a certificate from the competent authority. For persons with disabilities, the certificate must be valid on the last date of application. Only permanent residents (natives) of Bihar get the reservation benefit. Residents of other states cannot claim reservation. Reservation must be claimed in the column marked for it in the online form. The permanent address entered in the online form is the only address accepted for reservation. SC and ST candidates must hold a caste certificate and a permanent residence (domicile) certificate. BC and EBC candidates must hold a caste certificate, a permanent residence certificate and a non-creamy layer certificate. For unmarried and married women, the caste and non-creamy layer certificates must be issued from the father's permanent address. Certificates must be issued by the officer notified by the state government for the area of permanent residence. EWS candidates get 10% reservation where vacancies exist. They must submit an income and asset certificate in Annexure-1 (Format-1), issued by the competent authority. Women get 35% horizontal reservation where vacancies exist. The reservation category cannot be changed once the appointment process has started. The secretariat will fix the last date for submitting all certificates for the claims made in the online form. No claim will be accepted after that date. Candidates who have been debarred from examinations for misconduct by the UPSC, any State Public Service Commission or another selection commission cannot appear for the period of that order. The secretariat's decision on eligibility to sit the examination is final.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in Bihar Vidhan Sabha Junior Secretariat Assistant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 15 provisional posts: 7 Unreserved, 2 EWS, 4 SC and 2 EBC. Four of these posts are for women, and the number of posts may decrease or increase.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for Bihar Vidhan Sabha Junior Secretariat Assistant?
faq.answer: The last date for the online application is 6 December 2026, which is also the last date for fee payment. Applications open on 7 November 2026 from 11:00 AM.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for Bihar Vidhan Sabha Junior Secretariat Assistant?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed Intermediate or an equivalent examination in any subject from a Council or Board recognised by the State Government or the Central Government by the last date of application.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for Bihar Vidhan Sabha Junior Secretariat Assistant?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 18 years as on 01 August 2026. The maximum age is 37 years for General (Unreserved) men, 40 years for General women and BC/EBC candidates, and 42 years for SC/ST candidates.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of Bihar Vidhan Sabha Junior Secretariat Assistant?
faq.answer: The post is in Pay Level-2 (Rs. 19,900-63,200), plus other admissible allowances as per rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for Bihar Vidhan Sabha Junior Secretariat Assistant?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 600 for EBC, BC, EWS and Unreserved men who are native to Bihar, and for all candidates from outside Bihar. It is Rs. 150 for SC, ST and 40% or more disabled candidates native to Bihar, and for all women native to Bihar.

faq.question: Q7. How to apply for Bihar Vidhan Sabha Junior Secretariat Assistant 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the Apply Online link given in the notice (bvscap.in) and pay the fee by Net Banking, Credit Card or Debit Card. Then download the filled form and print two copies, each page showing the Bar Code and Application Number.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for Bihar Vidhan Sabha Junior Secretariat Assistant?
faq.answer: Selection is through an OMR-based preliminary examination of 100 questions and 400 marks, followed by a Hindi and English typing test on computer. A merit list is then prepared from the candidates who pass the typing test.

faq.question: Q9. Is there negative marking in the Bihar Vidhan Sabha Junior Secretariat Assistant exam?
faq.answer: Yes. One mark is deducted for each wrong answer in the preliminary examination, where each correct answer carries 4 marks.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates from outside Bihar claim reservation?
faq.answer: No. Only permanent residents of Bihar get the reservation benefit. Candidates from outside Bihar may apply, but they pay the Rs. 600 fee regardless of category.
